verdict.rationale: Bulk management, such as provisioning many keys or acting on many stored credentials at once, is a fair question for a security-key product with management tools, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows SK Manager and iePassManager handling functions and credentials one at a time, plus an unlimited number of registered accounts. None of it documents running an operation across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
